background.$description: Dracula background. Reference value; the editor surface is painted from the clay ramp.

current-line.$description: Dracula current line, per the official Dracula spec, which lists it identical to Comment. Note that many Dracula implementations paint the current-line band with #44475A instead — that value is stored as dracula/selection.

selection.$description: Dracula selection. Same value as current line in the official palette.

comment.$description: Dracula comment. 3.7:1 on #1B1B1B — low by design in the original theme.

cyan.$description: Dracula cyan — types, classes, structs. 12.4:1 on #1B1B1B.

green.$description: Dracula green — function and method names. 12.6:1 on #1B1B1B.

orange.$description: Dracula orange — parameters and arguments. 10.1:1 on #1B1B1B.

pink.$description: Dracula pink — keywords, control flow, operators. 7.2:1 on #1B1B1B.

purple.$description: Dracula purple — numbers, booleans, constants. 7.1:1 on #1B1B1B.

red.$description: Dracula red — errors and invalid tokens. 5.5:1 on #1B1B1B.

yellow.$description: Dracula yellow — strings and char literals. 15.4:1 on #1B1B1B.

background.$description: Alucard background, original. Reference only — this product's editor ground is #E6E2DB, which is why the accents below are darker than stock Alucard.

comment.$description: Alucard comment, original and unchanged. 4.5:1 on #E6E2DB — deliberately quieter than the code around it.

cyan.$description: Alucard cyan — types, classes, structs. Original #036A96, re-levelled -2.5 L* to clear 4.5:1 on the #DBD6CC selection band. 5.1:1 on #E6E2DB.

green.$description: Alucard green — function and method names. Original #14710A, re-levelled -1.4 L*. 5.1:1 on #E6E2DB.

orange.$description: Alucard orange — parameters and arguments. Original #A34D14, re-levelled -3.2 L*. 5.1:1 on #E6E2DB.

pink.$description: Alucard pink — keywords, control flow, operators. Original and unchanged; already clears. 5.9:1 on #E6E2DB.

purple.$description: Alucard purple — numbers, booleans, constants. Original #644AC9, re-levelled -1.2 L*. 5.1:1 on #E6E2DB.

red.$description: Alucard red — errors and invalid tokens. Original #CB3A2A, re-levelled -7.2 L*. 5.1:1 on #E6E2DB.

yellow.$description: Alucard yellow — strings and char literals. Original #846E15, re-levelled -7.3 L*. 5.1:1 on #E6E2DB.

current-line.$description: Alucard current line, per the official Dracula spec. The spec lists this identical to Comment in both palettes — Dracula does the same (#6272A4 for both). Reference value; the light editor's current-line band is painted from the clay ramp.

selection.$description: Alucard selection, per the official Dracula spec. A cool lavender-grey — it sits at only 1.2:1 against this product's #E6E2DB editor ground and reads cold beside the clay ramp, so it is stored for completeness rather than for binding. The accents clear 4.2:1 on it.
